en: Fixed remote MCP servers in headless and SDK sessions staying disconnected after an outage longer than 15 seconds, or reconnecting in a tight loop to a server that drops each connection right after it connects; repeated drops now back off, up to 30s
zh: 修复无头模式和 SDK session 中的远程 MCP 服务器在中断超过 15 秒后仍保持断开的问题，以及向连接后立即断开每个连接的服务器紧密循环重连的问题；重复断开现在会退避重试，最长 30 秒
